media.caption: Published 1850 with a U.S. military expedition report, Plate 37/No. 6 records ruins at Pueblo Bonito. Visible labels include Open Court and Estufa; these are the recorder’s labels, not recovered ancient room names. True/magnetic-meridian marks and an approximate Circuit about 1300 feet note appear, but there is no measured scale bar. Regular room rows and ruined areas do not supply one complete occupied phase, a census or the functions of every room. The scan retains the original bounds; no source geometry is traced or restored.
